How It Works

1. Submit Your Idea - Fill out the form with details about your feature request.

2. Community Review - Our community and team will review and possibly upvote your suggestion.

3. Development - Popular and feasible features get added to our development roadmap.

4. Implementation - When completed, we'll release the feature in an app update.

Submit a Feature Request

Have an idea to improve Salat-e-Mustaqeem? We'd love to hear it! Fill out the form below with the details of your suggestion.

Your request will open a pre-filled GitHub issue form where you can review and submit.
